summary: Phase 1 Diversity Experiments - Partial Results (Core 4 GBMs + Diversity Models)

analysis.key_finding: All diversity models (LogReg 0.742, ExtraTrees 0.732, RF 0.736) are TOO WEAK solo to help - they dilute blends despite lower correlation
analysis.rank_correlation_estimate: LogReg ~0.90, ExtraTrees ~0.88, RF ~0.89 vs XGB (based on MASTER_PLAN benchmarks)
analysis.feature_subspace: Subspace LGBMs (0.758-0.759) are weaker than full LGB3 (0.7598) - not worth it

conclusion: No diversity model from this batch earns a seat in the ensemble. Need stronger diversity candidates: Neural Networks (TabNet, MLP+Embeddings) or proper stacking with inner CV.
